snippet.title: Fate/Grand Order - Epic of Remnant Pseudo-Singularity III PV
snippet.description:
Steel your resolve! The next chapter of Fate/Grand Order: Epic of Remnant, Pseudo-Singularity III: The Stage of Carnage, Shimousa - Seven Duels of Swordmasters, is now available!

"Miyamoto Musashi...a strange woman encountered in the minute Singularity. The concept of Pruning Theoretical Phenomenon...and a being who continuously warps from one world to another...

Too much remains a mystery about this woman. Historically, Miyamoto Musashi was a man who made his mark on the world as a master swordsman. What reason could there be for these two who share a name to be split as they are?

A new story unfolds after Musashi reappears and reunites with everyone at Chaldea. The time has come for the Seven Duels of Swordmasters to begin."

For more information, please visit the official website: http://www.fate-go.us/shimousa/

For the latest tips, tricks, and contests, please follow the official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/FateGO.USA/
